# Multiple context providers inside a for-loop body: each iteration's
# nested locale provider must thread its loop-variable locale into i18n
# calls inside that iteration's subtree.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# The for-loop iterates locales; each iteration's i18n.numberInt call
# receives `l` (the loop variable, not the parent component's locale)
# as its locale arg.
grep 'for _, l := range m.locales' out/model.go
grep 'i18n\.NumberInt\(l, m\.n, "decimal"\)' out/model.go

# Verify the threading isn't accidentally using the parent's default.
! grep 'i18n\.NumberInt\(i18n\.DefaultLocale' out/model.go
! grep 'i18n\.GetTranslator' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:i18n"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var locales = ["en-US", "fr-FR", "es-MX"]
    var n = 1234
    for l = locales {
        i18n.locale(l) {
            text(value=i18n.numberInt(n, "decimal"))
        }
    }
}
